name: With Mirth in Funeral
source:
"The funeral was yesterday and they were still in the same cheap hotel. The room was barren and sparse like any other hotel Zoomer had been to. It smelled like smoke, dark and hazy, a cloying presence in the air."

Zoomer spends a lazy morning in bed with his "lover." Their conversation is pleasant enough, or rather, unpleasant enough. Then again, Evil's brother is dead.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/with-mirth-in-funeral]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“葬礼是在昨天举行的，他们还在同一家廉价酒店里。房间和祖默去过的任何其他酒店一样贫瘠而稀疏。闻起来像烟味，黑暗而朦胧，空气中弥漫着一种令人厌烦的气息。”

佐默和他的“爱人”在床上度过了一个慵懒的早晨。他们的谈话足够愉快，或者更确切地说，足够不愉快。话又说回来，邪恶的兄弟死了。

[来自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/with-mirth-in-funeral]Itch.io[/url]]
